from pathlib import Path
import json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
R=Path('/home/mark/lumo-paper-v2-20260921/papers/gdn-tree-scan-mlsys/v2/experiments/out-20260922T100028Z-e1-18cells');S=R/"campaign_snapshot"
cells=json.loads((S/"e1_cells.json").read_text())["cells"]
ids=[x["id"] for x in json.loads((S/"frozen_prefixes.json").read_text())["pilot"]]
A=set(ids[:4]);B=set(ids[4:]);records=[]
for c in cells:
 C=R/("cell_%02d_b%d_%s_%s_a1"%(c["index"],c["block"],c["arm"],c["batch"]))
 events=[json.loads(l) for l in (C/"logs/e1_events.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if l]
 manifest=json.loads((C/"e1_manifest.json").read_text())["requests"]
 ps={e["physical_step_id"]:e for e in events if e["event"]=="physical_step"}
 outs={e["seq"]:e for e in events if e["event"]=="output_rows"}
 breaks={e["seq"] for e in events if e["event"]=="chain_break"}
 names={row["request_id"] for o in outs.values() for row in o["rows"]}
 meta={}
 for m in manifest:
  rid=[r for r in names if r==m["response_id"] or r.startswith(m["response_id"]+"-")]
  assert len(rid)==1;meta[rid[0]]=m
 def unit(rids):
  p={meta[r]["prefix_id"] for r in rids}
  if c["batch"]=="B1":
   assert len(p)==1
   return next(iter(p))
  if p<=A:return "A(1-4)"
  if p<=B:return "B(5-8)"
  return "cross-cohort"
 per={};glob={}
 for pid,p in sorted(ps.items()):
  nxt=ps.get(pid+1);rids=p["request_ids"]
  phases={meta[r]["phase"] for r in rids};phase=next(iter(phases)) if len(phases)==1 else "mixed_phases"
  reason=None
  if nxt is None:reason="terminal"
  elif any(meta[r]["phase"]!="timed" for r in rids):reason="preflight/warmup"
  elif nxt["seq"]!=p["seq"]+1:reason="intervening forward"
  elif any(p["seq"]<=b<=nxt["seq"] for b in breaks):reason="chain break"
  elif set(nxt["request_ids"])!=set(rids):reason="cohort change"
  elif len(rids)!=c["max_num_seqs"]:reason="occupancy ramp/drain"
  elif any(x.get("discarded") for x in outs[p["seq"]]["rows"]):reason="discarded"
  if reason is None:continue
  wall=nxt["t_start"]-p["t_start"] if nxt else None
  item=per.setdefault(unit(rids),{}).setdefault(phase,{}).setdefault(reason,{"count":0,"known_wall_s":0.0,"duration_unobservable_count":0})
  total=glob.setdefault(reason,{"count":0,"known_wall_s":0.0,"duration_unobservable_count":0})
  for v in [item,total]:
   v["count"]+=1
   if wall is None:v["duration_unobservable_count"]+=1
   else:v["known_wall_s"]+=wall
 timed_api={}
 for m in manifest:
  if m["phase"]!="timed":continue
  key=m["prefix_id"] if c["batch"]=="B1" else ("A(1-4)" if m["prefix_id"] in A else "B(5-8)")
  u=timed_api.setdefault(key,{"api_tokens":0,"requests":0,"finish_counts":{}})
  u["api_tokens"]+=m["n_api_tokens"];u["requests"]+=1
  u["finish_counts"][m["finish_reason"]]=u["finish_counts"].get(m["finish_reason"],0)+1
 records.append({"cell":c["index"],"batch":c["batch"],"per_unit_phase_exclusions":per,"global_exclusions":glob,"timed_api_by_unit":timed_api})
print(json.dumps(records))
